title: Patient Zero

plan.text: Three days to keep Dr. Hale alive
Hale's shunt starts failing: the broadcast
Leak the Halcyon memo through Ledger
The Tin Man on the rooftops

notes:
The party now knows the shunt is a beacon, not a medical implant. Dez wants to crack it; Patchwork wants it out of Hale's head.

The Tin Man got close enough to see. He didn't attack. Leave that hanging.

Ledger owes the crew a favour for the memo. He will pay it with the Cold Storage job.
recap:
Keeping Dr. Hale alive for three days turned out to be the hard part. Her neural shunt began to fail, and as it failed it started to broadcast: Halcyon could hear it, and so could something else.

Ledger dug up a Halcyon memo that called Hale "Patient Zero" and her shunt "the asset". The crew read it twice.

On the third night the Tin Man came across the Watson rooftops, close enough to touch. He looked at Dr. Hale, and walked away.
